items.facts_min_first: Mfanyabiashara aliweka euro {M} benki, kisha akatoa euro {S}.
items.facts_sub_first: Mfanyabiashara alitoa euro {S} benki, baada ya kuweka euro {M}.
items.question: Salio la akaunti likawa kiasi gani baada ya shughuli hizo?
items.distractor_sentence: Benki hiyo ina tawi namba {D} mjini.
items.agreement_note: euro invariant loanword for any numeral.
items.gloss_en: The trader deposited M euros at the bank, then withdrew S euros. What was the account balance after these transactions?

items.facts_min_first: Msimu huu, timu ilifunga mabao {M} na kufungwa mabao {S}.
items.facts_sub_first: Msimu huu, timu ilifungwa mabao {S} na kufunga mabao {M}.
items.question: Tofauti ya mabao ya timu hiyo kwa msimu huu ilikuwa ngapi?
items.distractor_sentence: Timu hiyo inacheza kwenye uwanja namba {D}.
items.agreement_note: mabao (class 6 plural of 'goal') is followed directly by the placeholder numeral, which never triggers a different agreement form.
items.gloss_en: This season the team scored M goals and conceded S goals. What was the team's goal difference for the season?
items.notes: Single team over a season, not a head-to-head match.

items.facts_min_first: Mwekezaji alipata faida ya dola {M} na hasara ya dola {S} mwaka huu.
items.facts_sub_first: Mwekezaji alipata hasara ya dola {S} na faida ya dola {M} mwaka huu.
items.question: Matokeo halisi ya uwekezaji wa mwekezaji huyo mwaka huu yalikuwa kiasi gani?
items.distractor_sentence: Mwekezaji huyo anamiliki hisa za kampuni namba {D}.
items.gloss_en: The investor made a gain of M dollars and a loss of S dollars this year. What was the investor's net result this year?

items.facts_min_first: Katika raundi ya pili, mchezaji alipata mapigo {M}, wakati par ya uwanja ni mapigo {S}.
items.facts_sub_first: Par ya uwanja ni mapigo {S}, wakati katika raundi ya pili mchezaji alipata mapigo {M}.
items.question: Matokeo ya mchezaji ukilinganisha na par katika raundi hiyo yalikuwa mapigo mangapi?
items.agreement_note: mapigo invariant plural noun after any numeral.
items.gloss_en: In the second round, the player scored M strokes, while the course par is S strokes. What was the player's result relative to par in that round?

items.sign_convention: team X's goals minus team Y's goals
items.facts_min_first: Timu A ilifunga mabao {M}, wakati Timu B ilifunga mabao {S}.
items.facts_sub_first: Timu B ilifunga mabao {S}, wakati Timu A ilifunga mabao {M}.
items.question: Timu A ilikuwa na tofauti gani ya mabao ukilinganisha na Timu B?
items.agreement_note: mabao (class 6 plural of 'goal') invariant after any numeral.
items.gloss_en: Team A scored M goals, while Team B scored S goals. What was Team A's goal difference compared to Team B?
items.notes: Question names party X (Team A) whose number is M.

items.facts_min_first: Mwanafunzi Neema alipata alama {M} kwenye mtihani, wakati mwanafunzi Zawadi alipata alama {S}.
items.facts_sub_first: Mwanafunzi Zawadi alipata alama {S} kwenye mtihani, wakati mwanafunzi Neema alipata alama {M}.
items.question: Neema alikuwa na tofauti gani ya alama ukilinganisha na Zawadi?
items.agreement_note: alama (marks, class 9/10 invariant noun) takes the placeholder numeral directly for any integer.
items.gloss_en: Student Neema scored M marks on the exam, while student Zawadi scored S marks. What was Neema's mark difference compared to Zawadi?
items.notes: Question names party X (Neema) whose number is M; invented generic names, no real people.
